Act2-3#1.zh: 话说史家村附近，有一群山贼霸占少华山，为首三名头目，底下聚集着五七百个小喽罗打家劫舍。领头的『神机军师』朱武，能使两口双刀；精通阵法，长于谋略。『跳涧虎』陈达，使一条白点钢枪。『锦花蛇』杨春，使一口大杆刀。
Act2-3#1.t: Near Shi Family Village, a band of outlaws had taken over Mount Shaohua. Three chiefs led five to seven hundred lackeys in raiding homes and robbing travellers. The leader was "Divine Strategist" Zhu Wu, who fought with twin swords, a master of battle formations and schemes. Then "Gorge-Leaping Tiger" Chen Da, with his white-speckled steel spear, and "Brocade Snake" Yang Chun, with his long-handled broadsword.

Act2-3#2.zh: 我们兄弟在这个少华山上大秤分金、整套穿衣、倒也是招惹了不少官府商人；今日听说华阴县出三千贯赏金要捉拿我们三人，总有一天官军会打上山寨。只是山寨中钱粮不是很多，何不乘机先去四周乡镇劫些粮草回来？等到官军进攻时，才有粮食可以长期御敌？
Act2-3#2.t: Up here on Mount Shaohua we brothers weigh out our silver by the scale and wear fine clothes by the set, and we've made plenty of enemies among officials and merchants doing it. Now I hear Huayin County is offering three thousand strings of cash for the three of us. Sooner or later the army will come up the mountain. We're short of money and grain, so why not raid the towns around us for supplies first? Then when the soldiers come, we'll have food to hold out.

Act2-3#3.zh: 大哥说的是。俺马上带一两百个喽罗去华阴县借粮，看他们给是不给！
Act2-3#3.t: Well said, brother. I'll take a hundred or two of the lads to Huayin County and borrow some grain. Let's see if they dare refuse!

Act2-3#4.zh: 二哥有所不知，如果要去华阴县，必须经过史家村；史家村的『九纹龙』史进是头猛虎，不可去招惹他；况且史家村三四百家都由史进组织训练，可不同于普通村庄。二哥何不去蒲城县？那里防备不周，必可有所收获。
Act2-3#4.t: There's something you don't know, second brother. To reach Huayin you must pass through Shi Family Village. Its "Nine Dragons" Shi Jin is a fierce tiger, best left alone. And all three or four hundred households there are drilled by Shi Jin himself. It's no ordinary village. Why not try Pucheng County instead? Their defences are weak, so we're sure to come back with something.

Act2-3#5.zh: 他奶奶的！当强盗连官府都不怕了，难道还怕一个村长！东怕一个村长，西怕一个县令，那在江湖上还混的下去吗？！
Act2-3#5.t: Damn it all! We're bandits, we don't even fear the government, and now we're scared of a village headman? Afraid of a headman here, afraid of a magistrate there. How could we ever show our faces on the rivers and lakes?!

Act2-3#6.zh: 哥哥说得有理；但是这个史进实在厉害....
Act2-3#6.t: You have a point, brother, but this Shi Jin really is formidable....

Act2-3#7.zh: 我也听说这个人十分英雄，有真本事。贤弟，还是不要去吧！
Act2-3#7.t: I've heard he's a true hero with real skill, too. Brother, better not go!

Act2-3#8.zh: 啊～～！你们两个闭上你们的鸟嘴！『长别人志气，灭自己威风！』他也是人，难道有三头六臂吗？俺不信！
Act2-3#8.t: Argh! Shut your damned mouths, the pair of you! "Puffing up the enemy and doing ourselves down!" He's only a man. Has he got three heads and six arms? I don't believe it!

Act2-3#9.zh: 你们快去备俺的马来！现在俺就带人踏平史家村，放火烧掉华阴县！
Act2-3#9.t: Saddle my horse! I'm taking the men to flatten Shi Family Village and burn Huayin County to the ground!

Act2-3#10.zh: 少华山山贼要踏平史家村，形势危急！
Act2-3#10.t: The Mount Shaohua bandits mean to flatten Shi Family Village. Danger looms!
